parsed.brief_reason: The patch fixes a NullPointerException by replacing a null reference (cAvailableLocaleSet) with the properly initialized cAvailableLocaleList. This is a minimal, one-line fix that addresses the root cause of the bug affecting all failing tests. The change maintains the same functionality while using an available data structure.
